_comment: sim-robust-collect-place-straightline-v1 (collect4). Purpose: let the honest COLLECT deck place COMPLETE after the upright preplace, without cuMotion rejecting the final place config. With the PR 209 goal fix + PR 213 parking-gate fix, collect4 reached the upright preplace AND the host planned the place descent, but cuMotion rejected the PLACE config as an ATTACHED-OBJECT SELF-COLLISION: 'Invalid c-space position: self collision detected' (host-stack.log: 6 self-collisions, 0 world collisions). The held carton is a 34-sphere cuMotion attached_object (isaac_motion.attach_object_world at gripper_tcp) NOT self-collision-ignored vs the forearm/wrist/upper-arm, so the set-down fold brings the carton spheres inside the attached-object self-collision margin EVEN THOUGH the bare arm is self-clear there (+0.0339 m at BOTH the upright preplace and the place) and PR 209's wrist-guard accepted the config (WRIST_GUARD accept q=[0.095,-1.503,1.839,-0.336,1.858,0]). The cart deck is NOT a cuMotion WORLD object for this run (world_obstacles:[], base_collision_object:false), so there is nothing to make collision-aware -- this is purely the conservative attached-carton self-check of the intended set-down. Fix = the cart-cage / live_pose (PR 215) mechanism: route the place descent + empty retreat as the collision-OFF straight-line seeded insert; the preplace standoff stays collision-aware. Absent/false => byte-identical.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController).
_collect_place_straight_line_note: Route the NON-cage COLLECT deck PLACE descent + empty-handed RETREAT through begin(straight_line=True) -- the SAME collision-off seeded 2-point insert the cart-cage place and the live_pose transfer place (PR 215) already use (one shared `straight` predicate in controller.py step(), no second mechanism). The PREPLACE standoff stays collision-aware (the fixed upright collect_place_preplace_shape joint goal), so the arm reaches the standoff ABOVE the deck with full collision checking, then lowers the carton straight down onto the deck and lifts straight back out -- touching the deck with the held carton is the intent, exactly like the straight-line contact descent at the pick. Scoped to the non-cage collect place (operation=collect, cart_cage_place false); transfer / live_pose / scripted-still runs are untouched. false/absent => the collision-aware joint-space place (byte-identical, i.e. the collect4 behaviour that cuMotion rejects). Validated in tests/test_restock_manipulation.py (test_collect_deck_place_*).
_requires: The HOST block must already carry the PR 209 upright place-goal keys (collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard) and reposition_before_place:true with cart_cage_place:false, plus the PR 211/213 descent/parking keys in their own blocks (RUNTIME collect_place_base_settle_m, HOST release_detach_timeout_s). Register collect_place_straight_line in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Run the UNCHANGED collect4 staging (GROUND-TRUTH collect RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=scripted, cage_collision filtered, transfer_carry weld+wrist_guard, PR 203/208/209/211/213 keys; the collect4 HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG) PLUS collect_place_straight_line:true in the HOST block, through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr; never --force; never touch the whispr service). Expected PASS: HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG shows collect_place_straight_line true; the place reaches the upright preplace as before, the place DESCENT no longer hits 'Invalid c-space position: self collision detected' / trajopt UNKNOWN_STATUS / MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=collect (the straight-line insert bypasses the attached-object self-check), the gripper-open detaches the weld (release_detach_timeout_s), the ground-truth place verify shows the carton resting on the cart deck, the arm stows to the transport pose, and collect reports DONE (transport_ready True) so couple can begin. If a DIFFERENT move now fails, capture its host-stack.log line (collision class + which config) rather than widening this switch.
